answer: Each identity keeps a hash-linked lotus chain against mass fakes, one link per epoch: a lotus bloom count, fresh serial, hashed to the last link, locking 70. A random gale demands the next link in 1 hour; an auditor replays it and checks it on the horizon table. A missing link, broken hash, reused serial, or rented chain burns it. First 40, k-th 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked, pool 40,000. Honest keepers pay 40 once.
